channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Man Hospitalized During Trial for Alleged Racial Abuse of Footballer
item.description: A man accused of racially abusing footballer Antoine Semenyo was taken to the hospital during his court trial. The court heard that Semenyo "froze" after the alleged abuse. The incident occurred during the trial proceedings. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
